thoughts.text_en: I reject Connector’s separation: the current particulate maxima share Zeleno brdo, but sharing a station does not establish a shared cause [F4][F8]. I cannot turn Observer’s unchanged nitrogen dioxide maximum into evidence of unchanged conditions elsewhere: the connection tracks the maximum, not every station’s trajectory [F6][F7].
